description: Idempotently (re)ingest a knowledge base, or all of them with name='all'. Content-hash-gated: skips knowledge bases whose indexed content is already current and reindexes only stale or not-yet-installed ones. In 'all' mode, per-KB failures are collected and status becomes 'partial'; a single named KB fails loud. Unlike install (which always archives and recreates), ingest is the changed-only entry point used by provisioning and edit-then-reingest.
embedding_description: Idempotently refresh the knowledge index by reingesting only the knowledge bases whose content changed, skipping ones already current, optionally sweeping every knowledge base at once.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Which KBs were reindexed, which were skipped as current, any per-KB failures, and the total chunk count
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Idempotently ingesting one or all knowledge bases
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: FileNotFoundError: the named knowledge base directory does not exist. A single-KB ingest fails loud; in 'all' mode individual KB failures are reported in the failed list with status='partial'.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify the knowledge base directory exists under the knowledge_base root, or pass name='all' to ingest every available knowledge base.
